summary.answer: Connected the health debit event to all nine literal direct registrations in the REFERENCES-listed source. The producer passes the matched post-debit item on the originating player; listed no-obj callbacks run as threaded handlers on that player. Crash and playing-state progression admit health; stable health type fails Takeo equipment and contract armor-shard success gates. Ajax/Torque/Turret/Dart/Hawk require exact names or weapon data whose compatibility with health remains unknown. Turret requests its placement helper before filtering the payload. Ajax/Crash totals re-read current full inventory. These are conditional source connections, not proof of active registration, health gained, persistent stats or live behavior.
unknowns: No proof all nine source registrations are active in HMH or precede a given use event; same-function dedup, removals, malformed entries and dynamic audiences can affect delivery.
No immutable itemtype/name/weapon guarantee between debit and each threaded handler read. Gate-time health exclusions for Takeo/contracts do not settle a payload mutated to another type.
No pinned asset proof that every health entry lacks cu01_item/concertina_wire_wz_item/barricade_wz_item/ultimate_turret/dart/eq_hawk combinations; these name gates remain conditional.
Ajax/Crash current total can reflect debit and concurrent updates or removal, with no thread join or ordering guarantee. A callback request is not guaranteed delivery or a fixed snapshot.

Unlock predicates, item placement/traces, stat update durability, challenge completion, server availability and deployment effects are opaque downstream boundaries. No whole-system absence or success claim.

review.reviewed_scope: Complete exact written claim and full current subjects, including unchanged receiver/argument, ordered source read/write/request, data, branch/loop/return, callable/capture/delivery, reset/cleanup/error, dependency, provenance and limitation fields. Recovered-source statements are assessed at their stated static request scope; unavailable provider/native/build/VM/runtime facts are not supplied. Historical statuses and original identity labels remain historical, not fresh proof.
limitations: Original/source-to-PS4 identity, effective settings/assets/data, VM/native ABI, opaque provider internals, online/server code, callback delivery and runtime results are unresolved except for the exact written static facts. No unknown is guessed.
Original author/model/effort annotations and prior review labels are navigation/history; this report does not establish missing historical provenance or replay a prior review.
The original path alias is a source locator; actual verified full-byte paths are recorded. This report does not claim a missing historic alias has been restored.
